show.description: Shravan, a quiet ex-soldier carrying his fallen comrade Vikram’s ashes home, rescues a mother and child before being falsely arrested and humiliated by a corrupt cop. A young lawyer, Varsha, steps in, exposing police corruption and criminal networks. As Shravan’s true identity emerges, he confronts ruthless mafioso Daaga, restores a hero’s honour, and proves what real courage means.
